digest.component_or_area: Jira bridge multi-project rehearsal test harness
propositions: Live multi-project rehearsal must run against ephemeral Jira DC instance instead of shared Cloud projects to enable creation/destruction of isolated throwaway projects per test run
Non-existent project keys must fail the pass in fail-closed manner with abort semantics, not mask as empty results in the fake transport
Cross-project contamination must be prevented by preview-gating every mutating scenario and asserting mutation targets exist only in intended project before sync
Real empty projects must be modelled as actual empty DC projects rather than keys existing only in mapping, and unknown projects must error as fail-closed
Scratch project cleanup must run on all exit paths including mid-run failures, with random per-run prefixes and session guard to prevent leaked data
Preview plan must be inspected for target project containment (outbound UPDATE key prefix, outbound CREATE _bridge_target_project field) before each sync is applied
